title: overbridge root config.yml
description: Settings that live outside the repos, at <OVERBRIDGE_ROOT>/config.yml. Each layer uses overbridge.yml's keys (see overbridge.schema.json), and any key may be left out because the layers merge.

repos.description: Per repo, by its name in repos.toml: applied over that repo's overbridge.yml.

buttons.description: Top panel buttons. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

status.description: Run in the worktree on each refresh. Prints text, or {"text", "color"}; printing nothing hides the button.

run.description: Run in the worktree, detached, when the button is pressed.

url.description: Opened when the button is pressed. {ws}, {repo}, {branch} and {pr} are filled in.

hooks.description: Shell commands run in the worktree. Only allowed in the root config.yml.

post-add.description: After a repo's worktree is added to a workspace.

post-checkout.description: After overbridge checkout claims a branch or PR.

post-pr.description: After overbridge pr records an open PR.

pre-remove.description: Before overbridge rm; a failure stops it unless --force.
